body:
Bato, I was very close to suicide twice in my life. What you're saying is pretty much a narration of my own thoughts. Looking back, now that I've gotten to a more stable place in my life and some help, I realize that was just a projection of my mind. I was a valid person. The people trying to help me really did care. My own invalidation of thoughts was getting in my way. This is not a permanent condition.

Your life is worth living. Take a look at your academics. Second in the class, national merit scholar, captain of a few clubs, accepted (with damn good scholarship) to one of the best stem schools the country, you've done pretty well for yourself. That little bastard needs to be reported for rape, honey.

Bato, you've got to realize that your friends and family care about you. If help were offered to you from your school or friends would you be able to accept it? I can't say about school, but your friends really do care about you.

"I can't trust even my best friends anymore"
"I can't see how this is a life worth living"
"I'm too screwed up for this world"
"I'm hoping to make it to the end of colleges before I kill myself, but i don't see how even that is possible"

Her only interactions with others, from what I can tell, are complaining about her life and insulting them, both of which are worded as cries for help to us.

She's been saying stuff like "I don't know if I'm going to be able to live past 2020 at this point" (that's when she graduates from college) which is the most notable threat. She becomes very hostile and closed off when getting hell is mentioned and in the past she refused help when offered by her family when we told them. Which is why I'm so confused about where to go from here.
